extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: elevator module for one 2 m grid cell and one storey, 2.2 x 2.2 x 3.0 m incl. corner posts
extras.notes: occupies one 2 m grid cell: corner posts (0.2 m) on the four grid nodes, glass shaft on the sides and the back, plaster front wall centred on the grid line (local y = -1, door side -Y) with the kit door opening 1.0 x 2.2 m, steel frame and threshold (top 0.105 like the kit thresholds); the grid cell centre lies 1.2 cm behind the origin (Blender +Y / glTF -Z) because the call panel and frame stick out at the front; stack modules every 3.0 m; landing door leaves 'elevator_slide_left' / 'elevator_slide_right' slide 0.47 m outwards along X behind the wall; the cabin ('elevator_cabin', with glass and ceiling light) moves along Z, 3.0 m per storey; call buttons and indicator show arrows only, no numbers; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
